_note: Curated energy/climate/macro events 2020-2025 for historical-echo matching against Polymarket odds. Each event is high-signal (publicly verifiable, price-moving) and dated to the day. Tags help disambiguate when multiple events cluster.

events.headline: WTI front-month futures crash below zero for the first time in history
events.context: Storage at Cushing filled to capacity during COVID demand collapse; May contract settled at -$37.63.

events.headline: OPEC+ agrees record 9.7 million bpd production cut
events.context: Largest coordinated supply cut in history, ending the Saudi-Russia price war and stabilizing crude through 2020.

events.headline: AMLO's MORENA party consolidates control of Mexico's energy regulator CRE
events.context: Slowdown of private renewable permits accelerates; CFE state utility prioritized over IPP solar/wind.

events.headline: Texas grid failure during Winter Storm Uri cuts Mexico gas supply
events.context: Mexico lost ~5 GW of generation as US export terminals froze; AMLO cited as justification for fossil self-sufficiency.

events.headline: IPCC AR6 Working Group I Summary for Policymakers released
events.context: Declared human-induced warming 'unequivocal' and 1.5C breach likely by early 2030s; framed COP26 stakes.

events.headline: COP26 Glasgow Pact agreed: 'phase down' of unabated coal
events.context: India and China watered down 'phase out' to 'phase down' in the final minutes; methane pledge launched separately.

events.headline: Russia invades Ukraine; Brent crude spikes above $100
events.context: Triggered the largest European energy crisis since 1973; LNG redirected from Asia to Europe at record premiums.

events.headline: Biden bans US imports of Russian oil, gas, and coal
events.context: Pushed WTI to $123 intraday peak; refiners scrambled for Canadian and Latin American heavy crude substitutes.

events.headline: EU agrees sixth sanctions package, partial Russian oil embargo
events.context: Seaborne crude ban by end-2022; Hungary carve-out for pipeline supply; tightened Atlantic basin balances.

events.headline: Mexico inaugurates Dos Bocas (Olmeca) refinery — Pemex flagship
events.context: AMLO's signature energy project, 340k bpd nameplate; persistent delays through 2024 mean ramp far below promised throughput.

events.headline: US Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) signed into law
events.context: $369B for clean energy via tax credits; reshapes solar/storage/hydrogen capex globally and pressures Mexican nearshoring.

events.headline: OPEC+ announces 2 million bpd headline production cut
events.context: Drew sharp White House rebuke ahead of US midterms; effective real cut closer to 1mbd due to existing under-quota members.

events.headline: COP27 opens in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt
events.context: Loss-and-damage fund agreed for the first time; no new commitments on fossil phase-down.

events.headline: G7 price cap of $60/bbl on Russian seaborne crude takes effect
events.context: Forced re-flagging and shadow-fleet expansion; Urals discount to Brent widened to $30+ for months.

events.headline: IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report SPM released
events.context: Final consolidated IPCC product before AR7; emphasized 'climate-resilient development' and near-term mitigation gap.

events.headline: OPEC+ announces surprise voluntary 1.16 million bpd cut
events.context: Eight members including Saudi Arabia cut outside the formal quota framework; Brent jumped $5+ on the open.

events.headline: Saudi Arabia announces additional unilateral 1 million bpd cut
events.context: Effective July 2023, repeatedly extended through 2024; Saudi production fell to ~9 mbd, lowest in years.

events.headline: Hamas attacks Israel; Middle East risk premium returns to oil
events.context: Brent gapped from $84 to $89; markets priced in regional escalation risk to Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea shipping.

events.headline: COP28 opens in Dubai under UAE presidency
events.context: Petrostate-hosted; controversy over fossil-industry attendees; pivotal final-text battle on phase-out language.

events.headline: COP28 final text calls for 'transitioning away from fossil fuels'
events.context: First-ever fossil-fuel reference in a COP outcome; OPEC pushback failed but 'phase out' was avoided.

events.headline: AMLO submits constitutional reform package, including energy sovereignty articles
events.context: Codifies CFE's preferential dispatch and Pemex's monopoly framing; lays groundwork for Sheinbaum's policy continuity.

events.headline: Claudia Sheinbaum wins Mexico presidential election by record margin
events.context: MORENA also secures supermajority in lower house; peso fell 4% next session on judicial-reform concerns.

events.headline: OPEC+ extends voluntary cuts through Q3 2024 with phased Q4 unwind
events.context: Market disappointed by signaled supply return; Brent fell 5% the next two sessions before stabilizing.

events.headline: Mexico Senate passes judicial reform allowing popular election of judges
events.context: Peso weakened to 19.8/USD; international investors flagged rule-of-law risk for energy contract enforcement.

events.headline: Sheinbaum inaugurated as Mexico's first female president
events.context: Cabinet signaled continuity on energy: state-led, fossil-anchored, with rhetorical (not capex) commitments to renewables.

events.headline: Donald Trump wins US presidential election
events.context: Peso fell to 20.7/USD overnight; renewable sector equities sold off on expected IRA rollback risk.

events.headline: COP29 opens in Baku, Azerbaijan
events.context: 'Finance COP' focused on $1T+ annual climate finance target for developing countries; Trump win overshadowed talks.

events.headline: COP29 closes with $300B/yr climate finance pledge by 2035
events.context: Developing countries blasted figure as inadequate; LMDCs walked out briefly during plenary.

events.headline: Trump announces 25% tariff threat on Mexico and Canada day-one
events.context: Peso fell to 20.6/USD on the post; manufacturers paused nearshoring announcements pending detail.

events.headline: Trump inaugurated; signs executive orders withdrawing from Paris Agreement and 'unleashing' US energy
events.context: Halts new offshore wind leases, accelerates LNG export approvals, rescinds EV mandate; renewable equities fell 6-12%.

events.headline: Trump signs orders imposing 25% tariff on Mexico and Canada, 10% on China
events.context: Peso fell to 21.3/USD; Sheinbaum announced retaliatory measures before a 30-day pause was negotiated 2 days later.

events.headline: Trump tariffs on Mexico and Canada take effect after pause expires
events.context: Peso opened at 20.9/USD weaker; auto sector and Mexico-based EV suppliers most exposed; OPEC+ separately confirmed April supply unwind.

events.headline: OPEC+ announces surprise April production hike of 411k bpd
events.context: Triple the planned monthly unwind; Brent crashed $7 on the announcement to ~$70 intraday, lowest since 2021.

events.headline: Brent below $60 intraday on combined Trump tariff escalation + OPEC+ supply
events.context: Demand-destruction fears from global tariff regime collide with OPEC+ supply return; deepest single-week crude decline since 2020.

events.headline: US-China announce 90-day tariff truce in Geneva
events.context: Equities rallied globally; oil rebounded to $66; peso strengthened to 19.4/USD on risk-on.

events.headline: US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites; oil spikes on Hormuz closure threat
events.context: Brent gapped above $80 intraday before Iran's measured retaliation calmed markets within 48 hours.

events.headline: OPEC+ accelerates supply unwind, full restoration of voluntary cuts by year-end
events.context: Saudi-led pivot from defending price to defending share; Brent settled at $66 with bearish forward curve.

events.headline: US Treasury sanctions Rosneft and Lukoil, expanding Russia oil pressure
events.context: Brent jumped $3 to $66 before fading; secondary-sanction risk on India and China refiners flagged but unenforced.

events.headline: COP30 opens in Belém, Brazil
events.context: First COP in the Amazon; Lula framed forest finance and Global South just-transition as central; US absent in delegation form.

events.headline: Mexico approves Plan Sonora 2.0 expansion with mixed-finance solar projects
events.context: Sheinbaum administration signaled willingness to involve private capital in solar after years of CFE-only framing.

events.headline: Pemex receives third sovereign capital injection in 18 months
events.context: $8B injection to service 2026 maturities; rating agencies maintained negative outlook citing structural cash flow gap.
